query_planning_or_comparison.description: The final graph contains enough information, but the generated query over-constrains labels or roles, chooses the wrong path, mishandles mixed date precision, or compares dates incorrectly.

answer_surface_form.description: The graph query returns a compatible, more specific, expanded, ISO-formatted, or country/demonym variant, but strict normalized exact match rejects it. Token F1 already gives partial credit to most of these cases.

graph_content.description: The required relation is absent from the final extracted graph or the extracted value conflicts with the reference answer. Query regeneration alone cannot recover these answers without unsupported outside knowledge.

recommended_fixes_before_full_run: Retry a valid SELECT query when it returns no rows, supplying execution feedback and asking the planner to remove unnecessary constraints.
Give the planner explicit mixed xsd:gYear/xsd:date ordering guidance and test date/lifespan comparisons.
Prevent the planner from treating a geographic qualifier in an entity name as a third comparison entity.
Add fair answer equivalence for full-date versus textual-date formats and country versus demonym forms.
Retain exact match and token F1; add a separately reported semantic-equivalence metric for expanded names, places, and more-specific medical terms.
Report missing_graph_fact and conflicting_graph_fact separately from SPARQL planning failures.
